title: Human-level control through deep reinforcement learning (DQN)
summary: Volodymyr Mnih and colleagues published Human-level control through deep reinforcement learning online in Nature on February 25, 2015. The paper describes a deep Q-network (DQN) agent that combines deep neural networks with reinforcement learning and reports evaluation on 49 Atari 2600 games using pixels and game scores as inputs.
significance: A documented deep-reinforcement-learning milestone establishing the DQN agent and its reported multi-game Atari evaluation.

verification.note: Nature verifies the title, full author list, online publication date of February 25 2015, Google DeepMind affiliation, DQN terminology, reinforcement-learning/deep-neural-network method and the reported 49-game Atari evaluation. The day-precision date is attached specifically to the Nature online-publication milestone; PubMed records the issue date as February 26 2015.
